style.backgroundSystem: dark textured charcoal #211D1A for poster hero, trust and CTA screens; warm off-white #FAF5EE for the bright packshot; warm dark wood table for scene shots

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium festive crab cuisine visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of dark textured charcoal #211D1A, warm off-white #FAF5EE, crab-shell orange-red accent #C9431F and muted gold accent #D9A94E with charcoal text #2D2A26; warm tone throughout; soft warm top light with gentle fill, soft contact shadows and appetizing natural sheen, never plastic-looking; bold brush-calligraphy display headlines only; consistent thin #D9A94E gold-line icons and rounded info labels; authentic food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; whole crab presented centered with garnish and spices kept at the edges; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no plastic-looking food texture.
style.presentationRules: whole crab presented centered on a dark plate or in a bamboo steamer; garnish and spices kept at the edges and never covering the product; stable warm tone across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte dark slate plate #1B1917, rustic dark wood table #2B241E, bamboo steamer weave
style.typography: bold brush-calligraphy display headlines only, short clean labels in #D9A94E or #FAF5EE, body text color charcoal #2D2A26
